overview.title: Emergency information
overview.description: Find public situation updates, warnings, help resources, or submit an emergency report.
map.title: Emergency map
map.description: Public-safe situation overview. Use the list view when a map is unavailable or inaccessible.
map.interactiveLabel: Interactive map of public emergency situations and help locations
map.noFeatures: No public locations with coordinates are available in this area.
map.selectionContextUnavailable: This public record has no revision reference, so it will not be attached to the AI conversation.
map.snapshotTitle: Information shown in this map area
map.actionsTitle: What do you need to do?
map.actionsDescription: Quick access to report an incident, check warnings, and find help near this area.
map.notConfigured: Map tiles are not configured. Use the location list below.
map.unavailable: Interactive map is unavailable. Use the location list below.
map.coverageNotice: The map and list show public-safe approximate information for the visible area only. No marker does not mean no emergency; move or zoom the map to load another area.
map.coverageTruncated: This area contains more locations than are shown. Zoom in to inspect a smaller area.
map.noData: No public-safe locations are currently published for this map area.
map.stale: Showing previously loaded public information because fresh map data could not be loaded. Check the timestamp before acting.
search.title: Search public emergency information
search.description: Find published situations, warnings, and emergency help locations.
search.placeholder: For example: flood, hospital, or province
search.label: Situation, facility, or alert
search.empty: No matching public information was found.
search.unavailable: Search is temporarily unavailable. Browse the public lists instead.
search.truncated: More matches are available. Refine your search to narrow the results.
alerts.title: Emergency alerts
alerts.description: Published warnings and corrections with their latest update status.
alertManagement.title: Publish an emergency alert
alertManagement.headline: Public headline
alertManagement.geometryNotice: Optional GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon. Coordinates are generalized before public display; do not enter protected or operational locations.
alertManagement.unavailable: Alert management is unavailable. No change was confirmed.
event.title: Situation details
event.description: Public information for this situation. Exact protected locations are not shown.
facilities.title: Facilities and services
facilities.description: Find publishable emergency facilities and service availability.
report.title: Report an emergency
report.description: Submit a short report. It is accepted only after the service confirms durable receipt.
report.caseDescription: This private continuation link is available in this browser session.
report.claim: Link this report to my account
report.claimRequiresLogin: Sign in with the same tenant, then retry to link this report.
nearby.title: Help near you
nearby.description: Approximate nearby information. Precise locations are never disclosed by default.
nearby.approximationNotice: Your device location is rounded before it leaves the browser. Sharing is optional.
nearby.permissionDenied: Location is unavailable or permission was declined. Browse the public map instead.
nearby.firstRun: Choose Find nearby information to share an approximate location once. You can also browse facilities without sharing your location.
nearby.resultsForApproximateLocation: Showing results for your approximate location. Your exact device coordinates are not displayed.
support.title: Emergency support
support.description: Browse public support pools and their purposes. Personal case information is not shown.
supportPool.title: Support pool
supportPool.description: Review the public purpose and eligibility information for this pool.
supportPool.financialSummary: Settled THB minor units: {{settled}} · earmarked: {{earmarked}} · remaining restricted pool liability: {{restricted}}
supportPool.financeNotice: These amounts are accounting projections in THB minor units. Earmarking is not a cash payment or proof of spending.
supportFunding.title: Support this response
supportFunding.description: Contributions use the platform's secure payment and reconciliation flow. No case-level personal data is exposed.
supportFunding.unavailable: Payment could not be prepared. No contribution was recorded as paid.
supportFunding.authRequired: Sign in to your account for this tenant before creating a payment.
supportFunding.pending: Payment is pending provider confirmation. The support total changes only after reconciliation.
supportFunding.poolUnavailableDescriptio: The pool could not be loaded or is not accepting contributions. No payment has been prepared.
dashboard.title: Emergency workspace
dashboard.description: Your emergency actions and case updates. Access to each record is checked by the service.
cases.title: My cases
cases.description: Cases visible to your account, subject to current authorization.
case.title: Case details
caseMessages.title: Case messages
caseMessages.unavailable: Messages could not be loaded or sent. Retry when service returns.
caseEvidence.title: Case evidence
caseEvidence.empty: No verified evidence has been attached.
caseEvidence.add: Add a private evidence file (up to 20 MB)
caseEvidence.failed: Evidence upload or verification failed. Retry when storage is available.
respond.title: Responder workspace
respond.description: Verified responders can review assignments within their authorized scope.
command.title: Emergency command center
command.description: Operations access is required. All actions are checked and audited by the service.
command.reviewRequiredBeforeClose: Complete the open verification, reassessment, or no-response review before resolving or closing this case.
reviewQueue.title: Case review queue
reviewQueue.empty: No open verification or reassessment items.
reviewQueue.unavailable: The review queue is unavailable. No item was marked complete.
reviewQueue.reason: Review findings and reason for completion

contactAttempt.failed: Contact attempt could not be recorded.

needs.title: Case needs
needs.description: Record verified case needs and track partial fulfilment.
tasks.title: Response tasks
tasks.description: Create auditable response tasks for this case.
tasks.noVerifiedResponders: No verified responders are authorized for this case yet.
tasks.protocolReviewConfirmed: I reviewed the current hazard safety protocol and this responder is eligible
tasks.cancelAfterCapabilityReview: Cancel offered assignment after authority review
facilityManagement.title: Emergency facilities
facilityManagement.description: Register facilities and publish only after verification.
facilityManagement.name: Public facility name
facilityManagement.unverifiedNotice: New facilities remain unknown and are not advertised as open until a verifier confirms them.
sponsorship.title: Sponsorship administration
sponsorship.description: Manage only sponsor pools and purposes within your authorized scope.
supportHistory.title: My support history
supportHistory.description: Your own support contributions and receipts.
state.unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. No report or change has been submitted.
state.denied: Your account does not have access to this record or action.
report.descriptionLabel: What is happening? Do not include another person's sensitive details.
report.evidenceLabel: Attach supporting photos, audio, or video (up to 20 MB each)
report.evidenceUploading: Your report is received. Uploading evidence securely…
report.evidenceFailed: The report was received, but the attachment was not verified. Retry the evidence upload.
report.evidenceInvalid: Remove unsupported files or files larger than 20 MB before submitting the report.
report.locationNotice: Location is optional. If shared, it is kept restricted and is not published on the public map.
report.locationUnavailable: Location was unavailable or permission was declined. You can still submit the report.
report.accepted: The service confirmed that your report was received.
report.unsubmitted: Not submitted. The service did not confirm receipt; please retry when it is available.
helper.title: Volunteer availability
helper.description: Choose whether to share coarse, temporary availability for emergency response discovery.
helper.optIn: I want to make myself available as a volunteer helper
helper.privacyNotice: The service rounds your location to a coarse grid, expires availability within two hours, and revokes outstanding disclosure grants when you opt out.
helper.unavailable: Availability could not be loaded or saved. Retry when service returns.
claims.title: Verified emergency information
empty.title: Nothing is published here yet
empty.listDescription: There are no public records in this view right now. This can mean no information has been verified and published for this area yet.
empty.detailDescription: This public record is unavailable or is no longer published. Check the latest map and public information instead.
claims.description: Public claims reviewed against independent source groups. Unreviewed and disputed information is not published.
intelligence.title: Intelligence review
intelligence.description: Register sources, preserve bounded excerpts, link evidence to claims, and review before public release.
intelligence.manualOnlyNotice: External feed retrieval is disabled. Only operator-entered excerpts are recorded; source registration does not fetch a URL.
intelligence.correctionOf: Correct or supersede an existing claim
intelligence.publicSummary: Public summary for a claim being verified
intelligence.unavailable: Intelligence service is unavailable or the current role cannot perform this action.
allocation.title: Restricted fund allocations
allocation.notice: Allocation reclassifies settled pool liability in the canonical ledger. It does not transfer cash or spend funds; disbursement remains a separate reviewed workflow.
allocation.position: Settled minor units: {{settled}} · earmarked: {{earmarked}} · remaining pool liability: {{restricted}}
allocation.unavailable: Allocation was rejected or the finance service is unavailable. Check the available restricted balance and retry.
federation.title: Trusted partner exchange
federation.description: Manage verified partners and queue bounded, expiring operational shares.
federation.boundary: Shares are stored as minimum-disclosure records and are not delivered externally. Partner records do not grant dispatch authority or cross-tenant read access.
federation.verificationRequired: A tenant emergency verifier must activate this partner.
federation.unavailable: Partner exchange is unavailable or this role cannot perform the action.
privacy.title: Privacy and legal holds
privacy.description: Place or release an auditable legal hold that pauses evidence cleanup.
privacy.notice: An active case hold protects all evidence in that case. An evidence hold protects only that item. Release requires a recorded reason.
privacy.verificationRequired: A verifier can place or release legal holds.
privacy.unavailable: The legal hold service is unavailable or this role cannot perform the action.
publicEntry.title: Emergency information and help
publicEntry.description: Check verified public alerts, view the response map, or report an emergency. If anyone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first.
publicEntry.activeDescription: Read the latest public warnings and follow current safety guidance.
publicEntry.noActiveAlerts: No active public alert is currently published. Open the emergency information page for the latest situation updates.
publicEntry.updateUnavailable: Current alerts could not be loaded. Do not assume there is no active incident; open All alerts and try again shortly.

geoSearch.description: Search a limited curated place list. Results do not include coordinates and will not move the map.
geoSearch.label: Province, city, dam, or airport
geoSearch.placeholder: For example, Bangkok or Pasak Jolasid Dam
geoSearch.empty: No match in the supported place list.
geoSearch.unavailable: Place search is unavailable. Please try again.
